# Inventory Manager Project Instructions

- [x] Verify project requirements and workspace setup
- [ ] Scaffold the React and Express application
- [ ] Implement inventory CRUD API and MongoDB integration
- [ ] Build the responsive inventory frontend
- [ ] Install dependencies and compile the project
- [ ] Create the VS Code launch task
- [ ] Complete setup documentation

## Project

Build a product inventory manager using React (Vite), Express, and MongoDB.

## Conventions

- Use JavaScript across the application.
- Keep Express API routes in `server/`.
- Keep React UI code in `src/`.
- Use environment variables for MongoDB connection settings.
- Support create, read, update, and delete inventory operations.
